meta.name: human-prose
meta.description: Write prose that doesn't read as AI-generated. Use whenever the user asks for help writing or revising an article, essay, blog post, short story, social post, newsletter, op-ed, cover letter, personal email, marketing copy, speech, LinkedIn post, Substack post, or any standalone prose, including casually phrased requests like "write me a quick post about X," "draft a blog post," "help me write this up," or "make this sound better." Also use whenever the user wants writing to feel "natural," "human," "less AI," "less like ChatGPT," "less formal," "less stiff," "more like me," or asks to remove AI tells, slop, or stiffness from existing text. Use for any prose-writing task by default, including short ones. Do NOT use for structured technical writing where formal register is correct (API documentation, legal contracts, scientific abstracts, formal reports, code comments). Those have their own conventions and shouldn't be casualized.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 写出自然真实的人类风格文字
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你想让文字读起来像人写的，避免AI痕迹
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your writing to sound natural and not like AI

howto.what: Claude 在写作时会避免 AI 常见特征，使用具体细节、多样句式和自然表达，使文章读起来像人写的，而不是机器生成的。
howto.when: 当用户要求撰写或修改文章、博客、故事等散文，或希望文字更自然、更像人写、去掉 AI 腔时触发。

say.text: 帮我改一段文字，让它读起来不像AI写的。
say.note: Claude 会修改原文，去除 AI 特征。

say.text: 写一篇关于远程工作的博文，要自然一点。
say.note: Claude 会生成一篇自然风格的博文。

say.text: 把这段话改得更像人写的，去掉AI腔。
say.note: Claude 会调整语句，使其更像人类写作。

howto.what_en: Claude writes prose that avoids common AI tells: uses specific details, varied sentence lengths, and natural vocabulary, making text read as human-written rather than machine-generated.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to write or revise any prose (articles, essays, blogs, stories, social posts, etc.) or wants writing to feel 'natural,' 'human,' 'less AI,' or similar.

say_en.text: Rewrite this paragraph so it doesn't sound like AI wrote it.
say_en.note: Claude will rewrite the text, removing AI tells.

say_en.text: Draft a blog post about remote work, make it sound natural.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a natural-sounding blog post.

say_en.text: Edit this to sound more human, less AI-generated.
say_en.note: Claude will adjust the text to be more human-like.
